headline: Next week's plan set: test whether slow 12-month momentum (the only direction that clears costs) improves intraday setups as a side filter, then size-conditioned stop width; replay records wait for the owner.
bullets: SIZETREND: big-gap days have 14% more range but no cleaner trends, so predicted size helps risk sizing, not direction-free entries.
D2 MOMSIDE (main study): keep intraday longs on strong 12-1 names and shorts on weak ones, scored against random skips of the same size; survivorship and point-in-time checks built in.
D1: widen stops on predicted-big days at the same dollar risk, scored net of the trade-smaller effect; low prior.
D3 replay records conflict with research rule 21 (replays are a filter, never a record) - goes to the owner after the fresh 11-16..11-17 audit.
Replay engine frozen for that audit (live quotes, conservative stops, live cost basis incl. scaled exits).
next: MOMSIDE plan (Builder), size-stop plan (Scout), fresh replay audit after Monday's close, FAMC from 11-16, reps tables 11-18.
